name: legal-ai
description: BestSign Legal AI skill bundle: multiple legal skills sharing one MCP server and one OAuth authorization. Currently provides deep contract risk review (upload local Word/PDF contracts, confirm stance/jurisdiction/language, run an LLM risk review, download the structured report); more skills to follow.
descriptionZh: 上上签智能法务技能集合：插件内多个法务技能（Skill）共用同一个 Legal AI MCP 服务与一次 OAuth 授权。当前提供「合同深度审查」——将本地合同（Word/PDF）上传至云端审查引擎，按用户立场/法域/语言执行大模型深度风险审查，并下载结构化审查报告；后续版本陆续增加其他法务技能。
